answer: Proposal: make pooling expensive. A live seat's reward claim needs a proof-of-work ticket at difficulty k×base, k counting live seats sharing its transaction ancestry, grouped by the chain from public ledger history — no issuer. One treasury feeding N masks pays N²×base per epoch: the fable of free pooling dies on arithmetic, while an honest seat pays base. Escape means disjoint capital per head — timber at market price, no bulk discount — so a mask wins only if its slice tops that root upkeep. Mixers bleach the trail's pigment; wealth still buys roots.
